AKN Design Group handles all aspects of permit coordination on your behalf. Our extensive experience in the DFW market ensures we are familiar with local regulations, allowing us to efficiently prepare and submit plans, manage inspections, and secure approvals. This managed process removes the administrative burden from homeowners, ensuring your project adheres to all local requirements and progresses smoothly.
